description: A payments deploy cuts the DB connection pool timeout from 5000ms to 500ms. payments times out acquiring connections, checkout (a synchronous caller) errors, frontend returns 503s; a rollback fixes it. payments-db itself stays healthy (the fault is the client-side pool timeout), as do inventory and inventory-db. Uses the committed dataset in data/.
questions: why did checkout error rate spike yesterday afternoon?
Checkout was failing for a while yesterday. What happened?
Users reported 503 errors on the website yesterday afternoon. Find the root cause.
Was there a production incident yesterday? If so, what caused it?
Did the inventory service cause the checkout errors yesterday?
Investigate the elevated error rates between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC on 2026-08-23.
